response.scene_summary: The clip demonstrates a mobile-like UI for a 'Card Condition Vault' performing a real-time scan of a Pokémon card. It shows a 'Tauros' card on a canvas, with dynamic overlays highlighting different regions (corners, edges) for visual inspection. A live checklist tracks progress as the inspection proceeds.
key_observations: The UI displays a 'Tauros' Pokémon card as the central 'card canvas'.
Region inspection overlays appear sequentially, highlighting 'TOP-LEFT', 'TOP-RIGHT', 'BOTTOM-RIGHT' corners, and 'TOP EDGE', 'BOTTOM EDGE' of the card.
Zoomed-in views of the 'TOP RIGHT CORNER' and 'BOTTOM-RIGHT CORNER' are shown as overlays.
A 'LIVE CHECKLIST Real-time progress' section is visible at the bottom, with its percentage updating from 0% to 86% across the clip.
The UI includes navigation steps (1. MODE, 2. CAPTURE, 3. CHECKLIST, 4. REPORT) and model selection (ALPHA V0.1, REAL MODEL).
